result.brief: 提出多帧事件表征与稀疏感知掩码、token 选择及位置感知多掩码解码的 MAE 预训练框架，提升长时复杂事件序列的动作识别性能。
result.reason: Multi-frame event representation with MAE-style ViT pre-training and sparsity-aware masking/token selection; a self-supervised visual representation contribution, though event-camera rather than standard video.
